title: Strategy check-in: initiative health map and action slate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a concise initiative health map and an actionable slate of asks for the upcoming monthly exec sync / QBR draft. Goal: give leadership a single-page view of which cross-functional initiatives are on-track, at-risk, or behind; root causes; recommended mitigations (resourcing, scope pulls, or schedule shifts); and clear decision points. Focus areas include serving runtime throughput (batching/KV cache), Dedicated capacity autoscaling, Private deployment security items, and Console observability surface improvements. Deliverables: 1) one-page initiative health map, 2) 6-slide executive slate for the QBR, 3) decision log with recommended exec asks and estimated cost/latency tradeoffs, 4) list of follow-up owners and dates.
acceptance_criteria: One-page initiative health map produced and validated by Eng/Product/Design leads
Executive slide slate uploaded to Drive and shared with GTM by 2026-03-18
Decision log with conservative cost/latency estimates for each recommended ask
All action items assigned with owners and due dates; dependencies surfaced in Linear

notes: Key trade-offs surfaced: (1) speed-to-fix (short-term routing fallback) vs long-term fix (kernel scheduling + autoscaler), (2) cost (additional infra headcount for 6–8 weeks) vs customer churn risk for two large accounts, (3) scope reallocation from Console polish to Dedicated SLA work. Recommendation: present two options to execs with clear decision points and contingency (canary + automatic fallback).
